title: Inheritance and Verdict
author: Felix Underhill
blurb: Quentin Winterbourne, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
